accepted_claim: The exact final Java public operation starts native 64-bit Windows workloads atomically in a Job Object, distinguishes root exit from whole-tree completion, terminates and drains descendants, retains original unsigned root status and explicit abortion, preserves borrowed output, and cleans up construction failures while suppressing secondary release failures. These standalone lifecycle cases pass on native x64 and ARM64.

reuse_selection.limits: Single-controller, 64-bit Windows, explicit direct argv/absolute executable and cwd/env copied, borrowed native output handle, null-device stdin. Unsupported platform/capabilities explicit UOE, Win32 operational errors IOException with captured GetLastError.
